request: Draw how MonoRail's Remote access server decides whether to serve a request that comes from a phone. The server only listens on 127.0.0.1. A request is served only when all of these hold: the Host header is the machine's tailnet name or loopback; the Tailscale-User-Login header is in the allowed logins list; and, for every path except the pairing path, the request carries the cookie of a paired device. Otherwise the request is refused.
